name: Original Story
teaser: Story line for SPT, from Journey to T***** to the Ending
description:
This mod creates a story line through a series of quests.

You can unlock traders during Journey to T*** and obtain tickets after Fallen Stars.

This mod also adds a new trader who provides the Story Quests. After completing the Final, you will receive the corresponding ending reward. Because of this, the ibeatthegameiswear code will be banned.

After completing the Final, you can convert the mod’s ticket items into the vanilla WTT-ContentBackPort items. If we get a Terminal mod in the future, these items may become useful.

All quest have not any require for level or llr, but maybe you will wait for many hours to unlock next quest, this designed by B*G.

⚠️ About the Story

This story is not a 1:1 recreation of the live version. It is my own adaptation and contains significant changes to the original story, settings, and events.

Please do not treat the story or lore presented in this mod as canon to the live version, and do not use this mod as a reference when discussing or interpreting the original story.

The changes are intentional. This mod tells its own version of the story.

for usage:

unzip file and enter folder until you see BepInEx or SPT_Runtime or both of them, copy them into your game path(which include EscapeFromTarkov.exe)
